'''Lluis Torner i Sabata''' (born 1961) is a Spanish physicist. He founded and lead [[ICFO]] from 2002 to 2024<ref>[http://www.icfo.eu ICFO]</ref> in [[Barcelona]], [[Catalonia]] (Spain). He is the recipient of the Leadership Award of the Optical Society of America,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Robert E. Hopkins Leadership Award {{!}} Optica |url=https://www.optica.org/get_involved/awards_and_honors/awards/award_descriptions/robert_e_hopkins_leadership_award/ |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=www.optica.org}}</ref> the Monturiol Medal,<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=S'atorguen les medalles Narcís Monturiol a Lluís Jofre, Anna Maria Serra i Lluís Torner — Sala de Premsa - Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) |url=https://saladepremsa2.upc.edu/al-dia/mes-noticies/2010/satorguen-les-medalles-narcis-monturiol-a-lluis.html |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=saladepremsa2.upc.edu}}</ref> Gold Medal of the City of Barcelona,<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Ficha de la medalla de oro al mérito científico a Lluís Torner {{!}} Ajuntament de Barcelona |url=https://ajuntament.barcelona.cat/distincions-honors/es/torner-sabata-lluis |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=ajuntament.barcelona.cat |language=es}}</ref> the Creu de Sant Jordi of the Government of Catalonia<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=El Govern distingeix amb la Creu de Sant Jordi 20 persones i 10 entitats |url=https://govern.cat/salapremsa/notes-premsa/422832/govern-distingeix-creu-sant-jordi-20-persones-10-entitats |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=Govern.cat |language=ca}}</ref> and the 2016 National Research prize of Catalonia.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=Lluís Torner rep el Premi Nacional de Recerca 2016 |url=https://govern.cat/salapremsa/notes-premsa/297802/lluis-torner-rep-premi-nacional-recerca-2016 |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=Govern.cat |language=ca}}</ref>

== Career ==
Lluis Torner received his PhD at the [[Polytechnic University of Catalonia]] (UPC) in 1989 after completing a five-year degree in physics at the [[Autonomous University of Barcelona]], both in Spain. Subsequently, he enjoyed post-doctoral appointments at [[CREOL]] of the University of Central Florida. He has been Full Professor at [[Barcelona Tech]] since the year 2000.

He works in [[nonlinear optics]] and its applications, with emphasis on [[optical solitons]]. His most cited research contributions are in the areas of light guiding and trapping, optical solitons, light's orbital angular momentum, and twisted photons.

Torner has been elevated to Fellow of the [[European Physical Society]], the [[European Optical Society]] and the [[Optical Society of America]] (currently Optica). He is also a member of the ''Reial Academia de Ciències i Arts de Barcelona'' (RACAB), the [[Institute for Catalan Studies|Institut d'Estudis Catalans]] (IEC) and the [[Real Academia de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales|Real Academia de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales de España]] (RAC).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Miembro de la Academia - Real Academia de Ciencias Exactas, Físicas y Naturales |url=https://rac.es/sobre-nosotros/miembros/academicos/electos/1027/ |access-date=2025-04-29 |website=rac.es}}</ref>
